# Contributing to Awesome Technology Podcasts

Thanks for helping build the best list of technology podcasts!

## How to add a podcast

1. Fork this repo
2. Add your podcast to the README table under the appropriate sector section
3. Include all required fields: name, website, RSS feed, description, host/publisher, cadence, sector(s), and a recent episode from the past 90 days
4. Open a pull request

## Guidelines

- The podcast must be active (published an episode within the last 90 days)
- Include the official show website and public RSS feed
- Use the normalized cadence: Daily, Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, or Irregular
- Pick the most relevant sector(s) from the existing taxonomy
- One-sentence description — no marketing fluff

## Format

Follow the existing table format:

```
| **[Podcast Name](https://website.com/)** | [▶️][play-slug] | [![Sector][badge-sector-slug]][filter-sector-slug] | [![Format][badge-format-slug]][filter-format-slug] | Weekly | Host Name | 45 min | One-sentence description. | [![X][icon-x]][social-slug-x] |
```

## Questions?

Open an issue or start a discussion.
